channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-16232 — Check Point SmartConsole
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Check Point SmartConsole contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to obtain an application login token and use it to authenticate with full administrative privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-48939 — iCagenda iCagenda
item.description: Threat Signal 80. iCagenda contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows the upload of arbitrary files in the file attachment feature, ultimately resulting in PHP code upload and execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-56291 — Balbooa Forms
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Balbooa Forms contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload which could allow uploading of executable files leading to full RCE.

item.title: CVE-2026-86060 — MikroTik RouterOS
item.description: Threat Signal 69. MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacker to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2020-12641 — Roundcube Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Roundcube Webmail contains an remote code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code via shell metacharacters in a configuration setting for im_convert_path or im_identify_path.

item.title: CVE-2020-11652 — SaltStack Salt
item.description: Threat Signal 73. SaltStack Salt contains a path traversal vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs which allows directory access to authenticated users. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2016-3715 — ImageMagick ImageMagick
item.description: Threat Signal 68. ImageMagick contains an unspecified vulnerability that could allow users to delete files by using ImageMagick's 'ephemeral' pseudo protocol, which deletes files after reading.

item.title: CVE-2021-27137 — DD-WRT DD-WRT
item.description: Threat Signal 61. DD-WRT contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to overflow an internal buffer used by UPnP and trigger a code execution vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2023-4911 — GNU GNU C Library
item.description: Threat Signal 71. GNU C Library's dynamic loader ld.so contains a buffer overflow vulnerability when processing the GLIBC_TUNABLES environment variable, allowing a local attacker to execute code with elevated privileges.

item.title: CVE-2021-27561 — Yealink Device Management
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Yealink Device Management contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-14864 — Oracle Intelligence Enterprise Edition
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Path traversal vulnerability, where an attacker can target the preview FilePath parameter of the getPreviewImage function to get access to arbitrary system file.

item.title: CVE-2016-3976 — SAP NetWeaver
item.description: Threat Signal 73. SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains a directory traversal vulnerability via a ..\ (dot dot backslash) in the fileName parameter to CrashFileDownloadServlet. This allows remote attackers to read files.

item.title: CVE-2020-10181 — Sumavision Enhanced Multimedia Router (EMR)
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Sumavision Enhanced Multimedia Router (EMR) contains a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability allowing the creation of users with elevated privileges as administrator on a device.

item.title: CVE-2015-3035 — TP-Link Multiple Archer Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Directory traversal vulnerability in multiple TP-Link Archer devices allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a .. (dot dot) in the PATH_INFO to login/.

item.title: CVE-2007-5659 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a PDF file with long arguments to unspecified JavaScript methods.

item.title: CVE-2013-2729 — Adobe Reader and Acrobat
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Integer overflow vulnerability in Adobe Reader and Acrobat allows attackers to execute remote code.

item.title: CVE-2019-3568 — Meta Platforms WhatsApp
item.description: Threat Signal 67. A buffer overflow vulnerability in WhatsApp VOIP stack allowed remote code execution via specially crafted series of RTCP packets sent to a target phone number.

item.title: CVE-2021-28550 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains a use-after-free vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to achieve code execution in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2019-10068 — Kentico Xperience
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Kentico contains a failure to validate security headers. This deserialization can led to unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-125350 — Google Chromium
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2026-131914 — Idunno AntiCsrf
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

item.title: CVE-2018-4990 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Adobe Acrobat and Reader have a double free vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-6693 — Fortinet FortiOS
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Fortinet FortiOS contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that could allow an attacker to cipher sensitive data in FortiOS configuration backup file via knowledge of the hard-coded key.

item.title: CVE-2026-20320 — Cisco BroadWorks
item.description: Threat Signal 62. Cisco BroadWorks contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system.

item.title: CVE-2020-11651 — SaltStack Salt
item.description: Threat Signal 80. SaltStack Salt contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs due to improperly validating method calls. The vulnerability allows a remote user to access some methods without authentication, which can be used to retrieve user tokens from the salt master and/or run commands on salt minions. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2023-26359 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could result in code execution in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2019-1405 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 72. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when the Windows UPnP service improperly allows COM object creation.

item.title: CVE-2017-6736 — Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software
item.description: Threat Signal 72. The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS and IOS XE contains a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to remotely execute code.

item.title: CVE-2017-11826 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Office software when the software fails to properly handle objects in memory. An attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could run arbitrary code in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2017-0261 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Office contains a use-after-free vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2014-4114 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 72. A vulnerability exists in Windows Object Linking & Embedding (OLE) that could allow remote code execution if a user opens a file that contains a specially crafted OLE object.

item.title: CVE-2012-1856 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. The TabStrip ActiveX control in the Common Controls in MSCOMCTL.OCX in Microsoft Office allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted (1) document or (2) web page that triggers system-state corruption.

item.title: CVE-2014-1761 — Microsoft Word
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Word contains a memory corruption vulnerability which when exploited could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-0262 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Office.

item.title: CVE-2021-25296 — Nagios Nagios XI
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Nagios XI contains a vulnerability which can lead to OS command injection on the Nagios XI server.

item.title: CVE-2021-22991 — F5 BIG-IP Traffic Management Microkernel
item.description: Threat Signal 72. The Traffic Management Microkernel of BIG-IP ASM Risk Engine has a buffer overflow vulnerability, leading to a bypassing of URL-based access controls.

item.title: CVE-2021-27103 — Accellion FTA
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Accellion FTA contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability exploited via a crafted POST request to wmProgressstat.html.

item.title: CVE-2018-4939 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-11634 — Citrix Workspace Application and Receiver for Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Citrix Workspace Application and Receiver for Windows contains remote code execution vulnerability resulting from local drive access preferences not being enforced into the clients' local drives.

item.title: CVE-2020-15999 — Google Chrome FreeType
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Google Chrome uses FreeType, an open-source software library to render fonts, which contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the function Load_SBit_Png when processing PNG images embedded into fonts. This vulnerability is part of an exploit chain with CVE-2020-17087 on Windows and CVE-2020-16010 on Android.

item.title: CVE-2021-21220 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2020-0674 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to the way the Scripting Engine handles objects in memory. Successful exploitation could allow remote code execution in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2020-8243 — Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains an unspecified vulnerability in the admin web interface that could allow an authenticated attacker to upload a custom template to perform code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-123890 — Broadcom VMware vCenter
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

item.title: CVE-2013-1331 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Office contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via crafted PNG data in an Office document.

item.title: CVE-2012-4969 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2009-4324 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Use-after-free vulnerability in Adobe Acrobat and Reader allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted PDF file.

item.title: CVE-2015-4495 — Mozilla Firefox
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Moxilla Firefox allows remote attackers to bypass the Same Origin Policy to read arbitrary files or gain privileges.

item.title: CVE-2015-8651 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Integer overflow in Adobe Flash Player allows attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2012-1710 — Oracle Fusion Middleware
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Unspecified vulnerability in the Oracle WebCenter Forms Recognition component in Oracle Fusion Middleware allows remote attackers to affect confidentiality, integrity, and availability via Unknown vectors related to Designer.
